verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents Magic Link and email OTP as first-class passwordless sign-in methods, which covers half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows passkeys or WebAuthn support; documented MFA factors are limited to TOTP and phone. Missing for 10: passkeys/WebAuthn sign-in support, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the magic link/OTP flows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods

citations.quote: Sign up and sign in users with a Magic Link or email OTP instead of a password.
